artifacts.summary: 6-phase plan to anchor destructive-git guard matching to argv via an upfront multi-line quote-strip plus comment-strip, with the repository's first regression suite for the hook and a mandatory mutation check.

memory_candidates.content: When a shell guard strips quoted spans from a command string before flag-scanning, the strip MUST run once over the whole (possibly multi-line) input in slurp mode (sed ':a;N;$!ba') BEFORE any line-based segment extraction. A per-segment strip applied after a `grep -oE` segment split silently fails on any quoted span containing a newline, because grep never matches across lines -- the opening quote never finds its close, nothing is stripped, and free-text argument content gets flag-scanned as if it were argv. Ordering (strip-then-split, not split-then-strip) is the load-bearing property, not the regex. Corollary: a `#`-to-end-of-line comment strip closes the sibling false-exemption bypass and must be ordered AFTER the quote strip so a quoted `#` is already neutralized. Verified against guard-destructive-git.sh.
